thread:
rahul-recruiter: Quick one - Rahul (start 2027-01-10). Spouse filed H4 EAD renewal 2 wks ago. We have I-797C receipt but no SSN yet. Rahul asked if spouse can be added to dental/vision and commuter on day 1, and whether remote I-9 is doable. cc @nina-peopleops
nina-peopleops: Short: dental/vision often easier to provisional enroll w/ receipt; commuter depends on payroll vendor (TransitFlex). I-9 remote ok if WorkBright accepts receipt as List A proof for renewals. Need docs uploaded.
rahul-newhire: Uploaded I-797C, marriage cert, passport to candidate drive: https://drive.company/boxed/rahul/imm. Receipt ends in 6609. We use TransitFlex for commuter.
imm-attorney: Legal: receipt for H4 EAD renewal is commonly accepted for provisional enrollment and temporary I-9 verification for renewals. Must document "receipt presented; follow-up required upon EAD/SSN issuance." Keep a 45-day follow-up. If EAD denied, dependent coverage must be revoked per plan.
benefits-admin: For dental/vision we can request provisional enrollment effective 1/10 and mark "pending SSN/EAD". TransitFlex: they require SSN for commuter pre-tax payroll deductions; we can enroll but deductions will be paused until SSN provided. Will open vendor tickets.
lee-onboarding: WorkBright remote I-9 note: we can accept receipt for Section 2 if it's an EAD renewal case per policy. We'll schedule a live session 1/9. Laptop and basic accounts can be provisioned day 1; restrict admin/prod access until final docs.
payroll-bot: Payroll FYI: commuter pre-tax elections require SSN for tax reporting. If employee enrolls without SSN, TransitFlex may reject and payroll will not deduct until resolved. No tax penalties but employee may need to enroll again. For dental/vision premiums, deductions start as normal and vendor will reconcile once SSN provided.
nina-peopleops: Operational plan: 1) open TransitFlex case to ask if they can provisionally enroll and hold deductions; 2) enroll dental/vision as pending; 3) schedule WorkBright verification for 1/9; 4) add HRIS audit note and 45-day tickler. Approve covering employer portion for up to 30 days if vendor retro-bills employee portion.
rahul-recruiter: Hiring manager ok with covering employer share 30 days to avoid gap. Confirmed.
rahul-newhire: Thx! One question: commuter monthly passes — if deductions don't start, can we still issue a virtual transit card?
benefits-admin: We can issue a temporary voucher but pre-tax deduction won't apply until TransitFlex confirms enrollment. We'll coordinate with you and TransitFlex.
imm-attorney: Add legal note: keep all receipts and vendor responses in employee file; mark the case "pending EAD". If extension goes beyond 45 days request an exception and document business justification.
lee-onboarding: I'll book WorkBright slot and equipment. Rahul, can you do 1/9 at 10am PST for video verification?
rahul-newhire: Yes 1/9 10am PST works. I'll have originals ready.
payroll-bot: Noted. Payroll will await vendor reconciliation for commuter and process any retro adjustments in the next payroll cycle if needed.
nina-peopleops: I'll open the TransitFlex and dental/vision cases now and post vendor case numbers here by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
rahul-recruiter: I'll message Rahul and remind him to upload any EAD/SSN once received. Thanks team!
rahul-newhire: Appreciate the help 64f
